Creating Your First IntelliJ IDEA Project

The following steps describe how to create a functionining Java project in the JetBeans IntelliJ IDEA. The instructions assumes that you have already obtained and installed the following.

  • IntelliJ
  • BellSoft Liberica JDK 25 (Full JDK Package)

Steps - Creating a Basic IntelliJ IDEA Project

  1. Open IntelliJ and select New Project. Make sure IntelliJ is selected from the New Project screen and be sure that the BellSoft Liberica 25 is chosen as the JDK.

    1. Specify the name of your project in the Name field. Be descriptive, no but no spaces.
    2. Specify the directory where the new project should be created on your computer. You may want to create a specific folder for this class. Alternatively, you may create all projects in your IdeaProjects directory created during IntelliJ installation.
    3. Click Next.

      Figure 1: Splash Screen

  2. Right-click on the src directory and choose New -> Java Class. Enter `FirstClass’ as the class name.

    Figure 2: Create New Class

  3. In the editor window, add the code shown in the following figure to FirstClass.java.

    Figure 3: Add Code

  4. Right-click on FirstClass.java in the project directory and select Run.
